sync.headline: Monday is the crunch: the 1:00 audit draft review, then Nirmala and Kyle back to back. Read the draft, get Andy financials that tie to it, and send the three agenda emails.

themes.name: Deficit and forecast
themes.text: Academy revenue is projected $500,000–$600,000 under budget, and the October package is done. Paul leads a simple forecast for the Dec 8 board; KP supplies the numbers.

themes.name: Audit and board
themes.text: Nirmala presents adjusting entries at Monday's 1:00 draft review. Andy wants full financials that tie to the draft first; KP, Nirmala and Paul owe them.

themes.name: Showcase spending
themes.text: KP drafts a showcase spending policy for Nirmala's review Monday morning. His new fix list adds reimbursement policy, card receipts and who-gets-paid guidelines for coaches and directors.

themes.name: Finance capacity
themes.text: Nirmala asked for part-time accounting help and Bill.com to cut manual payables. KP's ask to Andy and Paul awaits an answer; the finance role requirements were due Nov 27.

themes.name: Healthcare
themes.text: Paychex put names on the wrong accounts, which held up the five-day open enrollment. Nirmala runs an all-staff plan review Monday at 3:00; KP owes staff the enrollment notice.

themes.name: Winter space and permits
themes.text: Winter indoor space is treated as set, but Little Red has given no prices; KP totals every contract over the break. NYC Parks spring permit renewals close Dec 14.
